description: Empilhar por nome com coluna de origem, depois despivotar.
sql:
WITH "v" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM READ_PARQUET('Vendas.parquet')
), "c" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM READ_PARQUET('Clientes.parquet')
), "u" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "uf" AS "uf",
      "cidade" AS "cidade",
      "data_txt" AS "data_txt",
      "preço_txt" AS "preço_txt",
      "quantidade" AS "quantidade",
      "data_venda" AS "data_venda",
      "valor" AS "valor",
      "ativo" AS "ativo",
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS "estado",
      'Vendas' AS "origem"
    FROM "v"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      "uf" AS "uf",
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS "cidade",
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS "data_txt",
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS "preço_txt",
      CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "quantidade",
      CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS "data_venda",
      CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "valor",
      CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS "ativo",
      "estado" AS "estado",
      'Clientes' AS "origem"
    FROM "c"
  ) AS "__u"
), "s" AS (
  SELECT
    "origem",
    "uf",
    "estado",
    "quantidade"
  FROM "u"
), "d" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "origem",
      "uf",
      'estado' AS "atributo",
      "estado" AS "valor"
    FROM "s"
    WHERE
      NOT "estado" IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      "origem",
      "uf",
      'quantidade' AS "atributo",
      CAST("quantidade" AS TEXT) AS "valor"
    FROM "s"
    WHERE
      NOT "quantidade" IS NULL
  ) AS "__unpivot"
), "o" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM "d"
  ORDER BY
    "origem" COLLATE NOCASE ASC,
    "uf" COLLATE NOCASE ASC,
    "atributo" COLLATE NOCASE ASC,
    "valor" COLLATE NOCASE ASC
)
SELECT
  *
FROM "o"
result:
origem,uf,atributo,valor
Clientes,PR,estado,Paraná
Clientes,RS,estado,Rio Grande do Sul
Clientes,SC,estado,Santa Catarina
Vendas,PR,quantidade,2
Vendas,PR,quantidade,3
Vendas,SC,quantidade,0
Vendas,SP,quantidade,1
